findings.text: errorControlChar passes lx.pos-1 to errorPos without bounds check; if a control character appears at position 0 (start of file), this sets Start=-1 causing invalid position or panic during error display.
errorPrevLine unconditionally sets pos.Start = lx.pos - 1 and decrements Line; if called when lx.pos=0 or at line 1, this produces negative Start or Line values causing incorrect error positioning.
errorf's atEOF branch sets pos.Start = lx.pos - 1 without checking if lx.pos is 0; unexpected EOF at file start would produce negative Start position.
